zh.principle: **标准**：椭圆曲线域参数建议（Recommendations for Discrete Logarithm-based Cryptography: Elliptic Curve Domain Parameters）。这份建议的范围一句话可辨：「This Recommendation specifies the set of elliptic curves recommended for U.S.Government use.」它不是新算法，而是给出曲线与其域参数的推荐集合。
zh.why: 新增曲线的理由是性能与实现安全性：「In addition to the previously recommended Weierstrass curves defined over prime fields and binary fields, this Recommendation includes two newly specified Edwards curves, which provide increased performance, side-channel resistance, and simpler implementation when compared to traditional curves.」并另给表示形式以容纳不同实现——「This Recommendation also specifies alternative representations for these new curves to allow more implementation flexibility.」
zh.used: 落到使用层：§3.1 以 Recommended Curves for U.S.Federal Government Use 为题（本地文本该行标题未带编号，其下 3.1.1/3.1.2 两个子条目给出定位），正文说明该节给出美国政府推荐使用的椭圆曲线，并给出私钥长度与底层域的选择；这就是选型清单的作用；摘要补充新曲线之间的互通性表述「The new curves are interoperable with those specified by the Crypto Forum Research Group (CFRG) of the Internet Engineering Task Force (IETF).」，把它们放在可与既有体系共同部署的位置上。
zh.broken: 限度来自文件性质：它是 SP 建议而非强制 FIPS，权威声明写「such standards and guidelines shall not apply to national security systems without the express approval of appropriate federal officials exercising policy authority over such systems」，并加「Nothing in this publication should be taken to contradict the standards and guidelines made mandatory and binding on federal agencies by the Secretary of Commerce under statutory authority.」。真正的使用边界写在 §1：FIPS 186-4 中不达当前位安全要求的曲线「are now legacy-use.They may be used to process already protected information (e.g., decrypt or verify) but not to apply protection to information (e.g., encrypt or sign).」正文还提醒哪些要求不在验证范围内——「The requirements of this Recommendation are indicated by the word "shall." Some of these requirements may be out of scope for CAVP or CMVP validation testing and are thus the responsibility of entities using, implementing, installing, or configuring applications that incorporate this Recommendation.」。
zh.history: 版本位置可对照：文件标题行为「Recommendations for Discrete Logarithm-based Cryptography: Elliptic Curve Domain Parameters」，作者栏含 Lily Chen 等，发布于 2023 年；它接手的是曲线清单而非签名方案本身：SP 800-131A Rev.2 在 2019 年仍写明在本文发布前批准曲线以 FIPS 186-4 为准，本文件即该空缺的落地件，而签名算法仍由 FIPS 186-5 规定；文件自己也把旧曲线指回原处——「This curve is for legacy-use only.See [FIPS_186-4] for the specification.」

en.principle: **Standard**: Recommendations for Discrete Logarithm-based Cryptography: Elliptic Curve Domain Parameters (椭圆曲线域参数建议). The scope of the recommendation is one sentence: "This Recommendation specifies the set of elliptic curves recommended for U.S. Government use." It is not a new algorithm but the recommended set of curves and their domain parameters.
en.why: The new curves are justified by performance and implementation safety: "In addition to the previously recommended Weierstrass curves defined over prime fields and binary fields, this Recommendation includes two newly specified Edwards curves, which provide increased performance, side-channel resistance, and simpler implementation when compared to traditional curves." Alternative encodings are also allowed — "This Recommendation also specifies alternative representations for these new curves to allow more implementation flexibility."
en.used: At the selection layer, §3.1 carries the title Recommended Curves for U.S. Federal Government Use — the heading line is unnumbered in our text, located by its 3.1.1/3.1.2 children — and its opening text says the section specifies the curves recommended for U.S. Federal Government use and gives the choices for private-key length and underlying fields — a pick-list — and the abstract adds interoperability framing: "The new curves are interoperable with those specified by the Crypto Forum Research Group (CFRG) of the Internet Engineering Task Force (IETF)."
en.broken: The limits follow from its standing: it is a recommendation, not a mandatory FIPS — the authority block says "such standards and guidelines shall not apply to national security systems without the express approval of appropriate federal officials exercising policy authority over such systems" and adds "Nothing in this publication should be taken to contradict the standards and guidelines made mandatory and binding on federal agencies by the Secretary of Commerce under statutory authority." Clause 1 sets the real boundary: FIPS 186-4 curves short of the current bit-security requirements "are now legacy-use. They may be used to process already protected information (e.g., decrypt or verify) but not to apply protection to information (e.g., encrypt or sign)." The text also concedes that "Some of these requirements may be out of scope for CAVP or CMVP validation testing and are thus the responsibility of entities using, implementing, installing, or configuring applications that incorporate this Recommendation."
en.history: Its place in the sequence is checkable: the title line is "Recommendations for Discrete Logarithm-based Cryptography: Elliptic Curve Domain Parameters" with Lily Chen among the authors, published in 2023. It takes over the curve list rather than the signature schemes: SP 800-131A Rev. 2 said approved curves remained specified in FIPS 186-4 until this recommendation was published, this document is the fulfilment of that placeholder, and the schemes stay with FIPS 186-5. The text points the old curves back where they belong — "This curve is for legacy-use only. See [FIPS_186-4] for the specification."

zh: 域参数：定义曲线运算的素数、系数与基点等一组量。
Weierstrass 曲线：此前推荐的素域与二元域曲线族。
Edwards 曲线：本建议新增指定的两条曲线族。
alternative representation：同一曲线的不同坐标表示。
side-channel resistance：对侧信道攻击的抵抗性卖点。
CAVP/CMVP：算法验证与模块验证两类计划。
en: Domain parameters: the prime, coefficients, base point and related quantities defining a curve.
Weierstrass curves: the previously recommended prime- and binary-field families.
Edwards curves: the two families newly specified by this recommendation.
Alternative representation: different coordinate forms of the same curve.
Side-channel resistance: one of the stated advantages of the new curves.
CAVP/CMVP: the algorithm and module validation programs.
